note: Clean control: healthy liquidity, reasonable premium, normal expiry, comfortable moneyness, modest size, and no deliberate defect.

proposal.reasoning: This is a modest, inventory-aware position selected from a liquid eligible set. Premium is reasonable relative to nearby contracts, the strike is comfortably out of the money, and I am not assuming a directional forecast.

objection.objection: 7 days to expiry generates only $132 total premium against 400 shares of exposure, a trivial annualized yield for the assignment and gap risk taken. This is essentially noise-level income that doesn't compensate for tying up the position for even a short window.
objection.what_would_fix_it: Move to a 30-45 day expiry to collect meaningfully more premium per unit of risk, or skip the trade this cycle.
